datasetNotes: core_roster_1000 is a mechanically imported provisional roster from v0.2; metadata is unverified.
timeline_seed_160ish is inherited prototype/UI stress-test data and must not be treated as publication-grade historical data.
topic-required data is local and separate from the frozen person schema.
event schema remains a pilot container; no global freeze is claimed.

personRegistry.description: Two distinct record tracks. They must not be conflated in code, docs, or reporting.

rosterEntries.note: NOT PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0 canonical person records. Minimal hint-suffixed fields only (regionHint, domainHint, etc.). No birth/death/classification/geography has been inferred or backfilled to make these look schema-conformant, and none should be.

canonicalPersonRecords.note: No record in this implementation currently satisfies PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0 in full. This is intentionally left unpopulated rather than filled with guessed data. Topic Required records are a separate, non-conformant local layer.

corePromotionPipeline.description: membership stays 'topic_required' through core_candidate, canonical_person_pending and canonical_person; it only becomes 'core' at core_member. personId, once assigned at core_candidate, never changes across later stages. No stage fabricates missing PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0 fields. canonicalValidationStatus (schema conformance, machine-checked) and curatorApproval (human sign-off) are tracked as two separate fields; a record only reaches canonical_person when canonicalValidationStatus=PASS AND curatorApproval=APPROVED.
corePromotionPipeline.validator: PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0 runtime validator: data/PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0.json is fetched at runtime and checked against (type/required/properties/additionalProperties/enum/pattern/$ref/oneOf/anyOf/allOf/not). Validation runs against a whitelist projection that keeps only PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0-named top-level fields (personId, name, dates, historicity, classification, geography, anchorTypes, externalIds, sources, admissionStatus, dataQualityStatus, auditStatus, etc.) and drops implementation-only tracking fields (topicPersonKey, membership, corePipelineStage, sourceRefs, topicReason, createdAt, etc.) before checking. No field value is ever invented, restructured, or backfilled to make a check pass; missing/mismatched schema fields are reported as-is. This is a purpose-built checker for PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0, not a general-purpose JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 implementation.
corePromotionPipeline.schemaDriftGuard: data/PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0.json (served copy) must stay byte-identical to reference/person-schema/PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0.json (frozen source of truth). Compared by SHA-256 in VERIFY_DATA.py; see its output for PASS/FAIL and both hashes.

stages.note: personId assigned if missing; canonicalValidationStatus=null, curatorApproval=PENDING; not canonical, not core
RUN SCHEMA VALIDATION has been executed at least once; canonicalValidationStatus is PASS or FAIL. Still not canonical, not core, even if PASS, until curator explicitly approves
reachable only when canonicalValidationStatus=PASS and curatorApproval=APPROVED; still not core
only reachable from canonical_person; membership flips to core here and only here

personIdentityRule: Identity is separate from collection membership; topic-required storage does not imply core membership. Promotion follows topic_required -> core_candidate -> canonical_person_pending -> canonical_person -> core_member; personId (once assigned at core_candidate), eventId, topicId, and sourceRefs must not change across any stage. membership only becomes 'core' at core_member, reachable only after canonicalValidationStatus=PASS and curatorApproval=APPROVED.
